summary: Sign in and out as a returning customer
description: The account menu, the cart and the invoice history all depend on a session. Signing in has to be provable from the page, and signing out has to actually end it.
acceptanceCriteria: A registered customer signing in with the correct password reaches their account page.
The account menu appears in the navigation once signed in, and is absent when signed out.
Signing in with a wrong password does not establish a session and the form reports it.
Signing out returns the navigation to its signed-out state.
